scope: Calcite focused workspaces and presentation-only map state. No new thresholds, AGOL items, permissions or private storage changes.

browser.environment: In-app browser; local app; 1920x1080, 1280x720 and 390x844 viewport overrides; anonymous public-source session
verified: Seven labeled tabs expose only their focused default layer groups, with Area Watch as the landing workspace
Weather and Reservoirs have separate panels; legacy conditions and release-chart links resolve to the correct workspace
Countywide area, regional NWS and power counts remain unchanged across all seven tabs, map changes and future weather time selection
Independent 2D scale restoration exactly matches after switching tabs; Back/Forward returns to the correct workspace
Optional FEMA context stays with its workspace; source refreshes do not re-enable unrelated layers
3D initialization followed by rapid tab changes ends in the destination workspace 2D preset; returning restores the original workspace 3D mode
Camera choices restore independently per tab; wide-screen dock and phone Sheet close behavior verified; cameras start closed
Phone Map/List controls and labeled account/help menu remain usable without header overlap
Keyboard arrows focus tab titles and Enter activates; Escape dismisses the camera Sheet
Fictional failed NWS feed retains dated evidence and an explicit failure; empty result never declares safe conditions
Initial county/regional extent is independent of partial feed arrival order; Fit workspace explicitly fits active watchpoints
limitations: Viewport tests emulate device sizes; physical EOC monitor, phones and a team tabletop remain county acceptance work
Forced GPU/context loss and expired private sign-in were not induced in the live county session; existing failure messages and publisher/auth regression contracts remain in place
Source coverage and timing gaps remain visible; this release adds no forecast model, local hazard threshold or dispatch logic

operation: Map state, layer choices and camera preferences exist only in page memory. Theme preference retains the existing non-sensitive persistence. Public collectors continue independently while the page is visible. Source issues deduplicate by underlying check rather than by area association.
rollback: Redeploy commit 1f480cfd8c1637840b3497126a8d27716f866756 (0.18.0). No data migration is required. Preserve later unrelated work.
